# M22-S5: .lgo builds are reproducible (SPEC Sec 22.5).
# The example module builds twice from clean caches for linux/amd64,
# linux/arm64, and js/wasm; each pair must have identical SHA-256 digests.
# A throwaway copy of the embedded .lgo sources under a fresh go.mod must
# build byte-identical output, proving the M22-S6 integration pattern
# (copied .lgo files plus a fresh go.mod) without touching
# test/logos/example. The stripped wasm size is gated against
# test/logos/size/wasm_size.txt: growth above 1% fails. Second-host
# comparison reuses the printed digests.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# Parameter: the example module directory this gate verifies. It defaults
# to the embedded multi-package .lgo fixture below, named as an archive
# directory. It also accepts an absolute directory: to verify the M22-S6
# example instead, copy its .lgo files into a scratch directory preserving
# package layout, write a go.mod with module example.com/order and go 1.27
# beside them, and set this variable to that directory. Every transition
# below anchors at $GOPATH/src first, so relative and absolute values work.
env LOGOS_EXAMPLE=repro

# The fixture runs before the matrix, proving it is a working program.
# It uses ? propagation, so the gate also pins lowering stability.
cd $GOPATH/src
cd $LOGOS_EXAMPLE
logos run .
stdout '^42$'

# linux/amd64: two clean-cache builds must agree.
cd $GOPATH/src
cd $LOGOS_EXAMPLE
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-amd64-a
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -o $WORK/exe-amd64-a$GOEXE .
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-amd64-b
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -o $WORK/exe-amd64-b$GOEXE .
cd $GOPATH/src
cd tools
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
go run . equal $WORK/exe-amd64-a$GOEXE $WORK/exe-amd64-b$GOEXE
stdout '^identical$'

# linux/arm64: two clean-cache cross builds must agree.
cd $GOPATH/src
cd $LOGOS_EXAMPLE
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=arm64
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-arm64-a
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -o $WORK/exe-arm64-a .
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-arm64-b
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -o $WORK/exe-arm64-b .
cd $GOPATH/src
cd tools
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
go run . equal $WORK/exe-arm64-a $WORK/exe-arm64-b
stdout '^identical$'

# js/wasm: two clean-cache cross builds must agree.
cd $GOPATH/src
cd $LOGOS_EXAMPLE
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-wasm-a
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -o $WORK/wasm-a.wasm .
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-wasm-b
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -o $WORK/wasm-b.wasm .
cd $GOPATH/src
cd tools
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
go run . equal $WORK/wasm-a.wasm $WORK/wasm-b.wasm
stdout '^identical$'

# Throwaway staging: the embedded .lgo sources under a fresh go.mod build
# byte-identical output to the embedded module build.
cd $GOPATH/src
mkdir staged
mkdir staged/calc
cp repro/go.mod staged/go.mod
cp repro/main.lgo staged/main.lgo
cp repro/calc/calc.lgo staged/calc/calc.lgo
cd staged
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-staged
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -o $WORK/exe-staged$GOEXE .
cd $GOPATH/src
cd tools
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
go run . equal $WORK/exe-staged$GOEXE $WORK/exe-amd64-a$GOEXE
stdout '^identical$'

# Stripped wasm size gate: growth above 1% against the recorded value fails.
cd $GOPATH/src
cd $LOGOS_EXAMPLE
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-wasm-strip
logos build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w' -o $WORK/example.wasm .
cd $GOPATH/src
cd tools
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
go run . sizegate $WORK/example.wasm $GOROOT/test/logos/size/wasm_size.txt
stdout '^wasm size ok: '

-- repro/go.mod --
module example.com/repro

go 1.27
-- repro/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/repro/calc"
)

func run() error {
	n := calc.Parse("20")?
	fmt.Println(calc.Add(n, 22))
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
-- repro/calc/calc.lgo --
package calc

import "strconv"

func Add(a, b int) int {
	return a + b
}

func Parse(s string) (int, error) {
	return strconv.Atoi(s)
}
-- tools/go.mod --
module example.com/reprocheck

go 1.27
-- tools/reprocheck.go --
// Command reprocheck verifies M22-S5 reproducibility artifacts.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

var errUsage = errors.New("usage: reprocheck equal <a> <b> | sizegate <wasm> <sizefile>")

func main() {
	if err := run(os.Args[1:]); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "reprocheck:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

// run dispatches one named operation over its file arguments.
func run(args []string) error {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		return errUsage
	}
	switch args[0] {
	case "equal":
		return equal(args[1:])
	case "sizegate":
		return sizegate(args[1:])
	default:
		return errUsage
	}
}

// digest returns the hex SHA-256 of the named file.
func digest(path string) (string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

// equal fails unless two files share one SHA-256 digest.
func equal(args []string) error {
	if len(args) != 2 {
		return errUsage
	}
	a, err := digest(args[0])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	b, err := digest(args[1])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Println("sha256:", a)
	fmt.Println("sha256:", b)
	if a != b {
		return errors.New("digests differ")
	}
	fmt.Println("identical")
	return nil
}

// sizegate fails when wasm grew over 1% past the recorded size.
func sizegate(args []string) error {
	if len(args) != 2 {
		return errUsage
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(args[1])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	recorded, err := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimSpace(string(raw)), 10, 64)
	if err != nil || recorded <= 0 {
		return errors.New("recorded size is not a positive integer")
	}
	info, err := os.Stat(args[0])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	actual := info.Size()
	fmt.Printf("wasm size ok: %d bytes (recorded %d)\n", actual, recorded)
	if actual*100 > recorded*101 {
		return fmt.Errorf("wasm size %d exceeds recorded %d by over 1%%", actual, recorded)
	}
	return nil
}
